description: This file contains shell script functions for configuring and managing GRE (Generic Routing Encapsulation) tunnels, including setup, teardown, and initialization for IPv4 and IPv6 variants, as well as related network interface management.

methods.name: gre_generic_setup
methods.description: Configures a generic GRE tunnel with specified parameters and updates the system via JSON.

methods.name: gre_setup
methods.description: Sets up a GRE tunnel based on mode and peer address, resolving IP and handling routing dependencies.

methods.name: proto_gre_setup
methods.description: Initializes GRE setup with default mode 'greip'.

methods.name: proto_gretap_setup
methods.description: Sets up a GRETAP tunnel and adds network interfaces.

methods.name: grev6_setup
methods.description: Configures an IPv6 GRE tunnel, resolving IPv6 peer address and handling routing.

methods.name: proto_grev6_setup
methods.description: Initializes IPv6 GRE setup with default mode 'greip6'.

methods.name: proto_grev6tap_setup
methods.description: Sets up an IPv6 GRETAP tunnel and adds network interfaces.

methods.name: gretap_generic_teardown
methods.description: Removes network devices associated with a GRETAP tunnel.

methods.name: proto_grev6_teardown
methods.description: Placeholder for IPv6 GRE tunnel teardown.

methods.name: proto_gre_init_config
methods.description: Initializes GRE configuration parameters including IP addresses.
